# Permissions

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs:permissions` from server/src/authz/permissions.ts and server/src/authz/routes.ts. Do not edit by hand: the test suite fails when this file differs from the catalogue. -->

The permission catalogue has 79 permissions and 14 built-in roles. A permission is `resource:action`; a role is a set of permissions, and `system-admin` holds every one. Tenants add custom roles built only from these permissions (B-3302); `GET /api/authz/matrix` shows them alongside the built-in roles. Every request goes through one pipeline in `server/src/authz/policy.ts`: role, credential scopes, tenant, clearance, zone ceiling.

An admin permission is any permission outside the member baseline: a custom role holding one needs a second admin to approve each version (dual control).

## Built-in roles

| Role | Name | Second factor | Granted by | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `system-admin` | System admin | required | `system-admin` | Everything, across tenants: zones, platform, baseline guardrails. |
| `tenant-admin` | Tenant admin | required | `system-admin` | Workspaces, members, quotas and roles inside one tenant. |
| `identity-admin` | Identity admin | required | `system-admin`, `tenant-admin` | User stores, group mappings, clients, sessions and signing keys. |
| `model-admin` | Model admin | required | `system-admin`, `tenant-admin` | Model catalogue, approvals, profiles and pool placement. |
| `guardrail-admin` | Guardrail admin | required | `system-admin`, `tenant-admin` | Guardrail rule sets, classifiers and promotion to enforce. |
| `tool-admin` | Tool admin | required | `system-admin`, `tenant-admin` | Registry review, MCP servers and tool approvals. |
| `knowledge-curator` | Knowledge curator | no | `system-admin`, `tenant-admin` | Knowledge bases, sources, relabelling and workspace memory. |
| `ml-admin` | ML admin | required | `system-admin`, `tenant-admin` | Training jobs, datasets and approvals for confidential data. |
| `workflow-admin` | Workflow admin | required | `system-admin`, `tenant-admin` | Publishes workflows and scripts as tools, and designs low-code apps. |
| `connection-admin` | Connection admin | required | `system-admin`, `tenant-admin` | Data connections, credentials and schema allow-lists. |
| `flag-reviewer` | Flag reviewer | no | `system-admin`, `tenant-admin` | Works the review queue within their clearance. |
| `member` | Member | no | `system-admin`, `tenant-admin`, `identity-admin` | Chat, knowledge and tools within their clearance. |
| `legal-review` | Legal review | required | `system-admin` | Grants or refuses licence exceptions for imports and keeps the licence allow-list. |
| `auditor` | Auditor | required | `system-admin`, `tenant-admin` | Reads the audit chain and usage. Nothing else. |

## Routes per permission

From the route permission registry (`server/src/authz/routes.ts`, B-3304): every route the server registers declares the permission it requires, and the test suite fails for a route that does not. A route listed under several permissions requires all of them; one marked "or" accepts any one of the permissions it is listed under. Handlers may narrow further (clearance, ownership, workspace membership).
